replay_source: User-supplied local console; complete JSON remains local.
interpretation: Mean effective rank of isotropic is higher than other arms; simple rank-collapse account for isotropic poor retrieval is not supported.
Isotropic loses markedly more whole-fold retrieval than residual-tangent, suggesting cross-slide region-identity confusion may be an important failure mode.
Residual-tangent retains superior same-region retrieval with less average effective rank, so latent dimensionality alone cannot explain identity performance.

At lambda=0.01, train-standardized scanner probe matches raw probe to four decimals in the reported summary, not supporting a material scale artifact at that setting; other lambdas and nonlinear probes remain unresolved.
Fold-global top1 retrieval is a scanner-to-reference same-region metric, not proof of biological label sufficiency.
Twenty-fold scanner/seed repeated rows are not independent biological replicates; inference, where used, must cluster at 48 source slides.
followup: Run a distinct reproducibility-checked two-arm identity collision audit measuring per-region correct-match cosine margins to hardest within-slide and cross-slide impostors, aggregating to source-slide inference; no RT3 promotion.
